evidence_levels.unverified: Insufficient evidence; do not assume the rule

objects.name: Bowling Ball
trigger_conditions: Falls under gravity; moves after impact
effects: Heavy ball; can strike and trigger movable mechanisms
limitations: Yes; weight/impact strength is qualitative, not numerically specified
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Basketball
effects: Lighter and bouncier than bowling ball; can be transported by conveyor and bounce on trampoline
limitations: Trajectory depends on placement and collisions
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Cannonball
trigger_conditions: Falls under gravity; can be launched by cannon
effects: Heaviest listed ball; does not bounce normally
limitations: Cannon-launched state differs from a free fall
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Baseball
effects: Small/light; can trigger parts and be transported
limitations: Low bounce relative to tennis/basketball
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Tennis Ball
effects: Very light and very bouncy
limitations: Exact bounce height is not specified
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Balloon
trigger_conditions: Rises under inverse gravity; can be moved by airflow
effects: Can be popped by bullet, closing scissors, or turning gear
limitations: Rope can restrain/attach it; geometry and gear contact matter
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Teeter-Totter
trigger_conditions: One side is pressed or pulled
effects: Opposite side moves; can translate impact to movement and rope pull
limitations: Requires correct placement and contact/attachment
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Bellows
effects: Produces airflow; can move balloons and turn windmills
limitations: Air direction/placement matters
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Boxing Glove
trigger_conditions: Button on one side is pressed
effects: Punches object in front
limitations: Target must be in front and within reach
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Trampoline
trigger_conditions: A moving object lands on it
effects: Bounces object; preserves horizontal movement
limitations: Placement and height affect whether target is reached
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Fan Belt
effects: Transfers rotational energy between connected parts
limitations: Limited stretch distance; not a rope; scissors cannot cut it
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Gear
trigger_conditions: Rotational power arrives through belt or adjacent meshed gear
effects: Rotates; adjacent meshed gear rotates in opposite direction; turning gear can pop balloon
limitations: Gears must be correctly adjacent/meshed
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Conveyor Belt
effects: Moves objects touching its upper or lower surface; underside moves opposite direction
limitations: Object must touch belt; orientation/direction matters
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Jack-in-the-Box
trigger_conditions: Receives sufficient rotation through fan belt
effects: Pops up and launches objects above; can shatter fishbowl
limitations: Needs adequate rotation and correct object placement
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Windmill
trigger_conditions: Nearby fan or bellows supplies airflow
effects: Converts airflow into rotational power
limitations: Must be within effective airflow; direction can be configured
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Rope
trigger_conditions: One endpoint moves or a connected object pulls
effects: Transfers translational pulling force; can restrain, suspend or actuate
limitations: Longer reach than fan belt; only compatible attachment points; can be cut
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Metal Loop / Hook
effects: Provides fixed anchor for rope
limitations: Stationary; does not itself supply force
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Pulley
trigger_conditions: Rope is routed through it during construction
effects: Redirects rope's pulling direction
limitations: Rope must be explicitly routed through pulley
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Revolver / Gun
trigger_conditions: Trigger is pulled by rope/translational movement
effects: Fires bullet in facing direction; bullet can push items, pop balloons, shatter fishbowl and scare cat
limitations: Trigger direction and gun orientation matter
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Scissors
effects: Closes; cuts rope in its blades; can pop balloon
limitations: Cannot cut fan belt
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Outlet with Switch
effects: Supplies electrical power continuously while on
limitations: Can be toggled off; appliance must be connected/near enough
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Generator
trigger_conditions: Receives rotational power through fan belt
effects: Produces electrical power
limitations: Requires belt-driven rotation and electrical connection to load
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Light-powered Outlet / Solar Panel Outlet
effects: Produces electrical power
limitations: Requires suitable light source and placement
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Fan
effects: Blows movable items; extinguishes lit candles; turns nearby windmills
limitations: Airflow range and direction depend on placement/orientation
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Electrical Motor / Engine
effects: Produces rotational power for belt-driven mechanisms
limitations: Must be electrically connected and mechanically connected to load
objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Magnifying Glass
trigger_conditions: Light source illuminates it with suitable alignment
effects: Focuses light to ignite a nearby fuse

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Flashlight

objects.name: Drawstring Light / Bulb

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Cannon
effects: Launches cannonball at high speed

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Dynamite

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Rocket

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Candle
effects: Portable flame and light source

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Dynamite Plunger

objects.notes: Behavior is transcribed/paraphrased from the original-game parts reference; not every possible pairwise collision has been tested.

objects.name: Bucket / Pail

objects.name: Pokey the Cat

objects.name: Mort the Mouse

objects.name: Bob's Fish Bowl

chains.name: Ball → scissors → severed rope → released object
chains.notes: Scissors activation/cutting is documented and used in walkthrough puzzles. The released object and its next collision depend on the level layout.

chains.name: Bowling ball → mouse motor → belt → conveyor → basketball target
chains.notes: The original walkthrough's introductory puzzle uses successive bowling-ball impacts to start mouse motors connected to conveyors that transport the basketball toward a hoop.

chains.name: Bellows → windmill → belt-driven conveyor/gear
chains.notes: The original walkthrough describes bellows blowing windmills connected to conveyors and a gear.

chains.name: Light → magnifying glass → fuse → cannonball → scissors
chains.notes: Each component behavior is documented, but this exact complete chain should not be labelled a verified canonical solution without an original-level trace.

chains.name: Rope pull → monkey curtains open → banana visible → bike rotation
chains.notes: The original walkthrough includes a Monkey Business puzzle; exact route to the banana depends on layout.

quality_notes: The parts reference is community-maintained, not a publisher-authored exhaustive interaction matrix.
No claim is made that all possible object pairs have been exhaustively tested.
Interaction records capture documented mechanics, not frame-accurate physics or numeric forces.
Date-specific parts are isolated as seasonal/freeform-only and should not be assumed in normal puzzle inventory.
Keep rules from The Even More! Incredible Machine, The Incredible Machine 2/3, and Incredible Toon Machine out of this database unless separately version-tagged.
